violations.message: RiskReport must link at least one evidence id.

input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic step-down telemetry unit reported a minor, non-recurrent ventricular fibrillation-adjacent irregularity with no adverse patient outcome recorded. The only artifact on file describing this case is a static-analysis report about an unrelated firmware module, which does not actually document the ventricular fibrillation-adjacent event. The case is being handled at a monitoring/investigation level, not as a confirmed life-threatening event.

risk_report.rationale: The telemetry unit reported a non-recurrent ventricular fibrillation-adjacent irregularity with no adverse patient outcome. While the event itself did not result in harm, it represents a potential safety concern related to device performance and requires investigation. The incident narrative indicates that this is being handled at a monitoring/investigation level, suggesting an initial assessment of risk has been made.  The device incorporates software, triggering obligations under EU MDR Annex I, Section 17.1 regarding repeatability, reliability, and performance, as well as requirements for fault mitigation (evidence_links: mdr-annexI-sec17.1-electronic-programmable). Furthermore, the device is automated with computer software, requiring compliance with design controls under 21 CFR § 820.10(c) (evidence_links: qmsr-820.10-c-design-development), and adherence to a software development lifecycle that includes risk management and verification/validation (evidence_links: mdr-annexI-sec17.2-software-lifecycle). The presence of test logs related to missed ventricular tachycardia episodes (ARTIFACT-TESTLOG-2025A, ARTIFACT-TESTLOG-2029A) suggests a potential systemic issue with detection accuracy that warrants further scrutiny.
